title: Sur une transformation simple des nombres p-adiques en nombres réels
notes: Defines the digit-reversal map sending a p-adic integer with digits d_i to the real series sum d_i p^{-i-1}. The balanced-ternary form used in this laboratory is an affine conjugate of that map. Real plots of 1-Lipschitz / automata functions after Monna transport, and the usual radix-p endpoint collisions, are classical; a project-specific jump-depth law would have to go beyond this coordinate change.
